title: Data protection
description: Conftest rules that deny making tables without point-in-time recovery, databases with under 7 days of backups, secrets deleted at once and logs kept under 30 days.

rules.data.rego:
package main

import rego.v1

# Data protection: what keeps data recoverable. Only things being made are checked, so removing a blueprint is never
# stopped by these rules.

creates(rc) if "create" in rc.change.actions

deny contains {"msg": "a table must keep point-in-time recovery on", "address": rc.address} if {
	some rc in input.resource_changes
	rc.type == "aws_dynamodb_table"
	creates(rc)
	not pitr_on(rc.change.after)
}

pitr_on(after) if {
	some p in after.point_in_time_recovery
	p.enabled == true
}

deny contains {"msg": sprintf("a database must keep backups at least 7 days, not %d", [days]), "address": rc.address} if {
	some rc in input.resource_changes
	rc.type == "aws_db_instance"
	creates(rc)
	days := rc.change.after.backup_retention_period
	is_number(days)
	days < 7
}

deny contains {"msg": "a secret must be recoverable for a while after it is deleted (a recovery window above 0 days)", "address": rc.address} if {
	some rc in input.resource_changes
	rc.type == "aws_secretsmanager_secret"
	creates(rc)
	rc.change.after.recovery_window_in_days == 0
}

deny contains {"msg": sprintf("logs must be kept at least 30 days, not %d", [days]), "address": rc.address} if {
	some rc in input.resource_changes
	rc.type == "aws_cloudwatch_log_group"
	creates(rc)
	days := rc.change.after.retention_in_days
	is_number(days)
	days > 0
	days < 30
}

warn contains {"msg": "an encryption key is deleted for good after its waiting period; 30 days gives time to notice", "address": rc.address} if {
	some rc in input.resource_changes
	rc.type == "aws_kms_key"
	creates(rc)
	days := rc.change.after.deletion_window_in_days
	is_number(days)
	days < 30
}
